title: Fixed inverse Ext evaluation transports normalized chart restriction
statement: Let f:X→S be a scheme morphism, F an abelian etale sheaf on X, q a natural number and h:V'→V an etale chart map over S. Let b be the induced chart map and j,j' its projections. The inverse fixed evaluation [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology-presentation] of normalizationCohomologyRestriction(f,q,F,h)(x) equals H.map of the inverse upperStarComp(b,j,j') coefficient map applied to cohomologyMap(b) of inverse fixed evaluation of x. Here x is any element of rawAffineRestrictedCohomology(f,q,F,V) [def-sbc-raw-affine-restricted-cohomology], and restriction is the specified unit-Leray construction [def-weil-pbc-raw-restricted-normalization-data]. There is no coherent coefficient, raw higher-image class, theta map, or affine hypothesis.

proof.text: Represent the Ext class as its shifted morphism. Use the proved transport_homology and pullback_commShift helpers to move derived section pullback through the represented morphism and the evaluation shift comparison. Inserting and cancelling the two exact single comparison isomorphisms gives evaluation_transport.

Apply derivedSectionPullback_single_unit and rightDerivedSingleUnit_zero to the constant integer sheaf. The proved map_zero_comparison helper identifies the resulting zeroth-homology map with ordinary section pullback. Naturality of the canonical zeroth comparison inserts the constant-sheaf isomorphism. Its definition by leftAdjointUniq, together with unit_rightAdjointUniq_hom_app for the global-sections/terminal-sections comparison, shows that this map sends the source integer generator to the target generator.

Evaluate the transport equation at the source generator. Mathlib Ext.mapExactFunctor_hom and Ext.comp_hom identify the transported represented morphism with cohomologyMap. The proved single_factor equation identifies pullback on the target single with rawAffineComplexPullback followed by its cochain single comparison. This proves the forward fixed-evaluation pullback formula.

Set r to the inverse evaluation of x. Apply injectivity of the target sheafHDerivedEquiv. Coefficient naturality sheafHToDerived_map and the forward pullback formula evaluate H.map of inverse upperStarComp after cohomologyMap. Cancel the forward/inverse evaluation at r, expand normalizationCohomologyRestriction, and use functoriality to identify both composites.

theorem sheafHDerivedEquiv_symm_restriction {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (q : ℕ) (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (V V' : S.Etale) (h : V' ⟶ V) (x : rawAffineRestrictedCohomology f q F V) :
    (sheafHDerivedEquiv
      ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (pullback.snd V'.hom f)).obj F) q).symm
        (normalizationCohomologyRestriction f q F h x) =
      Sheaf.H.map
        ((upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (normalizationChartMap f h)
          (pullback.snd V.hom f) (pullback.snd V'.hom f)
          ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @AlgebraicGeometry.Etale ⊤ f).map h).w.symm).inv.app
            F) q
        (cohomologyMap (normalizationChartMap f h)
          ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (pullback.snd V.hom f)).obj F) q
          ((sheafHDerivedEquiv
            ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (pullback.snd V.hom f)).obj F) q).symm x))
